known.via: English Wikipedia "La Jaraba" (redirects to "La Jaraba (Vino de Pago)") (a wine place on Wikidata)

climate: A dry climate, with little rain while the vines grow. Water is scarce and the dry air keeps disease down.

blurb.text: A Vino de Pago estate in El Provencio, formed in 2019 and inside the La Mancha DO area. A Vino de Pago applies to a single estate. Allowed grapes are Cabernet Sauvignon, Graciano, Merlot, Tempranillo and Sauvignon Blanc.
